M-TUI-RECORDS.Name: Records screen and help routing
M-TUI-RECORDS.Purpose: Retain workout browsing state, route records/dialog/help input, render the active screen, and display compact help/quit hints with errors.
M-TUI-RECORDS.Boundary: Ownership is limited to these six governed files. Existing data, persistence, dialog, and navigation helpers in the package remain outside this initial markup coverage.
M-TUI-RECORDS.Behavior: ? opens help outside dialogs; any key returns to records without running its records action. The borderless ? / q hints use the inactive-border color. gg selects the first row in the active panel, while G selects its last row; this applies to exercises and sets. Home and End remain supported.

M-TUI-HELP.Name: Records keyboard help
M-TUI-HELP.Purpose: Render titled shortcut groups in responsive columns with aligned descriptions and active-color keys, without an extra page heading.
M-TUI-HELP.Behavior: Arrange groups side by side when space allows and stack them on narrow terminals. Document home/gg for the first row and end/G for the last row. Any key returns to records; scrolling and display do not access persistence.

M-TUI-STARTER.Name: Application input wrapper
M-TUI-STARTER.Purpose: Load the records model and intercept Ctrl+C and Ctrl+Z as application-wide quit commands before child input handling.
M-TUI-STARTER.Behavior: Ctrl+C and Ctrl+Z emit quit outside help. In help every key, including both control shortcuts, is delegated so it returns to records rather than quitting.
